# reselling_vpc (Resource)

A private network (VPC) at one location. Servers join it with `reselling_vpc_member`, static routes are `reselling_vpc_route`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_vpc" "backend" {
  name        = "backend"
  subnet      = "10.20.0.0/24"
  location_id = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (String) Location (see `reselling_locations`).
- `name` (String) Name. Changed in place.
- `subnet` (String) Private (RFC 1918) network in CIDR notation between /16 and /29, for example `10.20.0.0/24`. Changing it replaces the VPC.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `gateway` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `prefix_length` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_vpc.backend <vpc_id>
```
